character_sheet: A small passive frog: an 8x11x2 body slab pitched forward 42 degrees, an 8x8 jaw plate hinged beneath it, two stubby front legs, two long jointed hind legs (a 9-long thigh and a 10-long shin each) and two eye nubs (ModelFrog.java:52-100, ten parts). 8 HP, speed 0.1, no fall damage and silent feet (Frog.java:70-75, :210-217). It hops: a random leap about every 70 ticks after a 50-tick cooldown (:96-108, :124-127) and one whenever it is hit (:229-236); it floats and is pushed by water (:65, :92-94); it hunts ants, butterflies, crickets, mosquitoes, fireflies and small worms within 8 blocks, biting for 3 and healing 1 on a kill (:220-226, :239-276); it croaks with a synched singing state of 35 ticks on half of its ambient rolls (:49-50, :183-192). A sneaking, empty-handed player pops it into a Boyfriend frog-prince or a Girlfriend princess in a puff of smoke (:132-179). It spawns in daylight above y 50, at most five together (:284-292; ModEntities.java:381-382). Read it as a frog: a squat, a leap with the hind legs kicked straight, a croak.
size_notes: Drawn at x1.0 of the rig, x0.5 as a baby (FrogRenderer.java:27, :39-40; shadow 0.35, :29) on a 64x64 sheet (ModelFrog.java:102), frogtexture.png (FrogRenderer.java:22); the hitbox is 0.75 x 0.75 (ModEntities.java:381-382). The original's ModelFrog(1.0f) argument was the wingspeed (ModelFrog.java:23), not a scale.

labels.body: body (an 8x11x2 slab pitched forward 42 deg; static)
labels.jaw: jaw (an 8x8x1 plate hinged at the body's pivot, resting 70 deg open; croaks while singing)
labels.lfleg: left front leg (1x5x1, splayed 27 deg; yaws with the gait)
labels.rfleg: right front leg (the mirror; yaws with the gait, opposite)
labels.lleg1: left thigh (1x9x2, rolled 13 deg out at rest; kicks to 140 deg in the air)
labels.rleg1: right thigh (the mirror; kicks to -140 deg in the air)
labels.lleg2: left shin (1x10x1, placed at the thigh's end by the code; yaws at half the gait, opposite the front leg)
labels.leye: left eye (a 1x2x1 nub on the head end of the body; static)

groups.name: gait
groups.amplitude: front legs: pi x 0.55 = 1.728 rad (99 deg) x the walking speed above a limbSwingAmount of 0.1, the right the negative; shins: half of that (49 deg), each opposite its own side's front leg; 0 below the threshold
groups.plain: the front legs paddle wide about the vertical with the stride, left against right, and the shins swing half as far the other way
groups.math: a = amount > 0.1 ? cos(t * 1.0 * 1.4) * pi * 0.55 * amount : 0; lfleg.yRot = a; rfleg.yRot = -a; lleg2.yRot = -a / 2; rleg2.yRot = a / 2
groups.phase: the limbSwingAmount threshold of 0.1 gates it
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 1.0 x 1.4: the natural period is 2 pi / 1.4 = 4.49 ticks

groups.name: jaw
groups.amplitude: singing: pi x 0.15 = 0.471 rad (27 deg) about the 1.22 rad rest; not singing: still at 1.22
groups.plain: the jaw plate croaks open and shut while the singing state runs, and hangs at its 70-degree rest otherwise
groups.phase: the synched DATA_SINGING int (Frog.java:49-50): set to 35 by getAmbientSound on half its rolls (:183-192), counted down to 0 (:115-120)
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 0.85: the natural period is 2 pi / 0.85 = 7.39 ticks; the state lasts 35 ticks (1.75 s)

groups.name: thighs
groups.amplitude: in the air (|vertical velocity| > 0.1): thighs rolled to 2.44 / -2.44 rad (140 deg, kicked straight out); on the ground: 0.227 / -0.227 (13 deg); the shins are re-placed at the thigh's end each tick (y = thigh.y - cos(zRot) x 9, z = thigh.z + sin(zRot) x 9)
groups.plain: the hind legs tuck when standing and kick straight out while the frog is rising or falling, the shins riding the thigh ends
groups.math: z = |dy| > 0.1 ? 2.44 : 0.227; lleg1.zRot = z; rleg1.zRot = -z; lleg2.y = lleg1.y - cos(z) * 9; lleg2.z = lleg1.z + sin(z) * 9; rleg2 likewise
groups.phase: the client-read vertical velocity (getDeltaMovement().y), not a synched flag
groups.omega_note: no natural period: a pose switch on the airborne test; the hop itself is jumpAround (Frog.java:96-108)

behaviour: One gait rhythm above a limbSwingAmount of 0.1 (ModelFrog.java:107-113): the front legs paddle 99 degrees x the walking speed about the vertical at 1.4 rad/tick (a 4.5-tick period), the right the mirror of the left, and the shins swing half as far the other way; at speed 0.1 (Frog.java:53) the stride is a slow paddle.

Two state branches. The jaw plate croaks 27 degrees about its 70-degree rest at 0.85 rad/tick while the synched DATA_SINGING count runs (ModelFrog.java:115-118; Frog.java:49-50, set to 35 at :188-189 on half the ambient rolls, counted down at :115-120) and hangs still otherwise. The thighs roll from a 13-degree tuck to a 140-degree kick whenever the vertical velocity passes 0.1 either way (:120-126) — the hop, which the entity fires at random about every 70 ticks (Frog.java:124-127, jumpAround :96-108) and on every hit (:231-234); the shins are re-placed at the thigh ends each tick (:128-131).

The body, the jaw's hinge and the two eyes are static; the head does not follow the look (there is no head bone). The bite on an insect (doHurtTarget, Frog.java:220-226, from the hunt at :243-252) and the prince transformation (:132-179, the frog is discarded at :135) draw no pose.

wishlist: in `walk`: a hop cadence rather than the code's paddle (ModelFrog.java:107-113) — the entity moves at 0.1 and leaps at random (Frog.java:96-108), so the walk should read as short hops with the thighs driving
in `jump`: the kick the code has (thighs to 140 degrees, :120-126) with a crouch before and a squat after; the shins today are simply re-placed at the thigh ends (:128-131) — key the joint instead
in `sing`: a throat swell — the jaw plate (:57-60) is the only croak the code has (:115-118); a body puff sells the 35-tick state
in `attack`: a tongue-lash is not in the rig — a jaw snap and a body lunge toward the insect (Frog.java:248-250) is what the parts allow
